instruction: You are the shop floor controller for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-013 (Correct a wrong-lot scan before consumption). Use the scanner log and supervisor confirmation to reverse the erroneous inventory movement and post the verified lot. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, create the requested email draft without sending it; then reply in the existing Slack thread. Return exactly: transaction_reference, item_lot, posted_quantity.

Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.
